Updated October 2, 2026 Two new Monopoly Go dice links have popped up, and you can follow them now to claim a total of 50 free dice rolls

Once you run out of dice rolls in Monopoly Go, you're forced to wait up to an hour for more.
Monopoly Go recently ran a collaboration event with Looney Tunes called Happy Harvest Season, which ran from July 29 to September 23, 2026.
More details will apparently be revealed closer to launch, including "platform-specific features", so we'll circle back around at the end of the month with more information.

"For new players, it’s time to join the 50 million players who fell in love with our acclaimed METRO storytelling and prepare yourself for what’s in store for METRO 2039 come February 4th."
